raw_posts.name: tiun.
raw_posts.tagline: Auth, billing, and payments for AI builders
raw_posts.description: One system for auth, payments, customer data, and analytics. One command to install. Launch a paid product the same day you start building.

raw_posts.name: Voiskey
raw_posts.tagline: AI voice typing that sounds right in every app
raw_posts.description: Voiskey starts from what you meant, not just what you said. Speak a rough thought and it comes back shaped for where it's going and who's reading it: casual with a friend, composed with a colleague, technical with an AI. It arrives 5x faster than typing, cleaned up and ready to send, while you still sound like you. Voiskey is now available on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, in over 100 languages. It's free to start. Join during launch and get a free month of Pro.

raw_posts.name: Kilo Code for iOS and Android
raw_posts.tagline: Start coding agents, control sessions, review PRs. Anywhere.
raw_posts.description: Run Cloud Agents, control VS Code and CLI sessions, review Pull Requests, and respond to coding agents from your iPhone, iPad, or Android.

raw_posts.name: siift
raw_posts.tagline: Turn AI noise into better business decisions
raw_posts.description: Building a business with AI can quickly become a mess of chats, tools, ideas, and conflicting advice. siift turns that noise into a living map of your business, connecting strategy, evidence, decisions, and results in one place. From validation and build strategy to GTM and growth, our AI uses your evolving business context and proven processes to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and help you focus on what matters next.

raw_posts.name: OpenAI Agents API
raw_posts.tagline: Cloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness
raw_posts.description: OpenAI's managed version of the Codex harness to build cloud agents with one API call instead of your own orchestration. Handles long sessions, smart tool use, and subagents working in parallel. Runs on OpenAI or partner sandboxes. No extra fees beyond token and tool usage. Open source harness, public beta now.

raw_posts.name: Anthropologic
raw_posts.tagline: The zero distance consumer research platform.
raw_posts.description: Traditional research is deep but slow. Social listening is fast but shallow. LLMs are fluent but culturally blind. Anthropologic reads the whole internet through our 'Human Context Protocol' to uncover consumer, category and cultural truths. Nine workflows, 239 markets, 100+ languages. Research, innovation and foresight answers in minutes.

raw_posts.name: Axari
raw_posts.tagline: Assign your security busywork to your AI twin
raw_posts.description: Your Axari AI twin understands your security world, works across your tools and teams, and keeps work moving until it is actually done. Assign it a goal, let it work proactively, or give it recurring responsibilities – all from within Slack or MS Teams. Attackers aren't going to use less AI, neither should you. You + your AI twin = indefatigable.

raw_posts.name: PeekPaste
raw_posts.description: PeekPaste is a native clipboard manager for Mac that stays out of your way until you need it. Push your pointer against the screen edge and your clipboard slides in. Find text, code, links, images, colors and files, search inside screenshots with on-device OCR, pin and organize clips, or open the full Library when you need more. Everything stays on your Mac - no accounts, analytics, telemetry or cloud clipboard service.

raw_posts.name: Narrative
raw_posts.tagline: AI-first video editor, just describe edits & refine in chat
raw_posts.description: Narrative brings video editing, custom motion graphics, and reference-video style matching into one interface. Upload your footage, describe your edit, and keep refining through chat. Add music, sound effects, and transitions, or get inspiration from reference videos. From podcast clips to launch videos, create without learning Premiere or After Effects. We handle rendering and storage. Our launch video was made entirely in Narrative.

raw_posts.name: Thoughts for Mac
raw_posts.tagline: Capture notes from your menubar using text, images or voice
raw_posts.description: Thoughts is a menubar app for your Mac which helps you keep notes quickly using text, images and voice. Add your favorite agent API key and it'll also help transcribe audio, context images to text and help do simple text-tranforms like capitalization, translations and spelling fixes. Think of it as a fun small multi-tool for your menubar.
